messages:
lucy: Opening a small PR to tighten the Quickstart flow: single-line auth for mac/linux and PowerShell, small healthcheck step after first deploy, curl + Node one-liners, GH Actions secret note, and a link fix for the k8s deploy section. I'll post the PR shortly.

naresh: love the PowerShell example — many Windows folks get stuck. Please show both `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and PowerShell: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = '...'`.

toni: also add a tiny local healthcheck hint: `curl http://localhost:$PORT/health` and mention default PORT=8080 on the platform.

lucy: done. curl example is one line for copy/paste: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-qa","prompt":"Hi"}'`

lucy: Node one-liner: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'; const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY }); c.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-qa', prompt: 'Hi' }).then(r => console.log(r.text));`

naresh: GH Actions snippet please (use secrets, don't echo): `env: REDWOOD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}` and show a masked step.

lucy: added the GH Actions example and a note: "Do not print secrets in logs". Also clarified model pinning for Dedicated customers: `model: redwood/fast-qa@v1.2.0` to avoid unexpected upgrades.

toni: small troubleshooting note: if responses are stale after deploy, clear browser caching of dev origin and check KV-cache TTLs with `redwood status` (link to internal troubleshooting doc).

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4488 — "Quickstart: auth one-liners, healthcheck, pwsh env & link fix" (author: lucy)

naresh: reviewing now. will add a couple inline wording tweaks for the healthcheck text.

lucy: thanks — aiming to merge before today's site build at 18:00 PT. ping here if any blockers. :shipit:
